officialCalculationStages.name: Price collection and corrections
officialCalculationStages.description: Sampled item-area quotes adjusted for quality and missing quotes; rents are contracted 6-month comparisons with special pure/economic rents
officialCalculationStages.upstream: Item/service prices, rent panels, quote adjustment methodology
officialCalculationStages.availability: Individual BLS survey microquotes/panels are not public for exact external reconstruction

officialCalculationStages.name: Basic index
officialCalculationStages.description: Mostly expenditure weighted geometric means of price relatives; some modified Laspeyres calculation
officialCalculationStages.accuracy: Exact only with exact area-item quote and weight data

officialCalculationStages.name: National aggregation
officialCalculationStages.description: Update category cost weights from weight reference period by component index relatives; sum non-overlapping categories
officialCalculationStages.accuracy: BLS special aggregate worked example reproduced; complete national CPI requires finer published/private item-area data

officialCalculationStages.name: Seasonal adjustment
officialCalculationStages.description: BLS X-13ARIMA-SEATS applies seasonal adjustments to elementary series and aggregates 81 components, with evolving relative importance
officialCalculationStages.calculation: NOT independently reconstructed; require first-vintage BLS SA and seasonal adjustment factors
officialCalculationStages.accuracy: No claim that sum of five SA baskets matches official headline exactly

officialCalculationStages.name: News reading
officialCalculationStages.description: SA MoM CPI headline and core published to 0.1 percentage point; annual headline CPI from NSA index
officialCalculationStages.calculation: round published first-release seasonally adjusted MoM; NSA YoY from original official news
officialCalculationStages.accuracy: Backtest should compare exact BLS announcement plus vintage index error

upstreamResearchCandidates.officialIndex: CPI Gasoline, energy commodities; energy services

hypotheses: Latest pump price swing
Partial-month weighting
Gasoline regional variation
Refinery and retail passthrough lag
Oil shock state
USD and demand interactions
Heating utility pass-through; regional and seasonality important

upstreamResearchCandidates.warning: Daily/weekly data only known as of the cutoff; no full-target-month average can be assumed before month-end

upstreamResearchCandidates.officialIndex: Rent of primary residence and Owner's equivalent rent

hypotheses: New-tenant rent gap predicts later continuing-rent response
Separate lease renewals and tenant mobility
candidateSources.releaseCaveat: BLS paused R-CPI-NTR publication in April 2026; use only dated historical releases

hypotheses: Market asking rents, distributed lags and vintage publication status
Six rental panels; 6-month geometric root; utility adjusted pure rent
January annual structure-weight update

upstreamResearchCandidates.warning: Do not copy rents posted today into historical past months. Correct arrival-time data vital; quoted Zillow vintages not yet archived.

upstreamResearchCandidates.officialIndex: Food at home and food away from home

hypotheses: Agricultural input costs and processing pass-through to food retail
Restaurant labor cost with variable consumer pass-through

upstreamResearchCandidates.warning: Food at home differs from restaurants; must split and validate import and supply chains

hypotheses: Upstream producer cost pass-through changes in high vs low demand regime
Commodity shocks, tariff and supply regime conditioning
Exchange-rate pass-through with distributed lag
Used car wholesale auction prices require independent source

upstreamResearchCandidates.warning: Avoid using published current month's CPI goods as a predictor of the same unreleased CPI month

upstreamResearchCandidates.officialIndex: Medical, transport, insurance, airfare, personal services

hypotheses: Unit labor costs and wage pass-through with regime variation
Weakening labor demand affects services price-setting
Actual ticket fares require independent advance quote feed
Insurance rate filings, repairs, claims experience lag

upstreamResearchCandidates.warning: Service subcomponents have different shock processes; blanket wages coefficient is insufficient

historicalTesting.strictForecastCutoff: 7 calendar days BEFORE each BLS CPI release
historicalTesting.realTimeSourceRule: ALFRED/BLS initial publications and time stamped original online datasets only
historicalTesting.modelSelection: Train/test split by release_date; adjust coefficients using earlier releases only
historicalTesting.targetMonths: Full monthly original BLS SA headline/core first-release quote; NSA YoY separate
safeguards: Skip missing series instead of backfill
Compare to rolling 3m CPI benchmark and contemporaneous Cleveland nowcast if archived
Report mean absolute error, exact tenth printed release hit rate, directional bias, intervals
Keep 2026 untouched from initial 2024-2025 fitting; new follow-up periods remain truly unseen
historicalTesting.operationalPromotionRule: Only promote after multiple independent windows show better headline and core CPI forecasts, not merely better individual categories
